definition: Systems or services that generate or disseminate timely natural-hazard warnings so people, institutions or responders can take protective action. Includes warning generation, cell broadcast, other public alerts and sector-specific warnings with an explicit climate or natural-hazard connection. Monitoring without warnings and specific adaptation advice are climate_information_systems. Includes protocols, rules and plans specifically about early warning. Excludes disease-outbreak or public-health surveillance and alert systems unless the warning is for a climate or natural hazard, and routine notifications, emergency call-taking, dispatch, damage reporting and post-event response communications without a warning function. An existing emergency system qualifies only when the project intervention adds or improves warning capability.
boundary: Not monitoring without warnings, which is climate_information_systems; not specific adaptation advice, which is also climate_information_systems; not emergency call-taking, dispatch or post-event communications; not disease-outbreak surveillance unless the warning is for a climate or natural hazard.
